title: 第13章 家族大比三第14章 意外
content_zh:
下面的观众也是兴奋起来了。
一直以来的废物突然变成锻体境高手，现在还要和家族现在年轻一辈的‘第一人’萧强进行对决。
就没有有什么比这更有吸引力的了！
只见萧强率先出手，一枪向前刺出，直取萧天胸口。
周边灵气也跟着萧强的招式流动，可见这一招的强大，也直接表明萧强已经是全力出击了。
看到这一幕，观看的众人都已经开始想象着萧天被一枪击飞的画面了。
毕竟在他们看来，两人的实力可是有着六层境界的巨大差距呢。
所以也难怪都不看好萧天。
只有萧玄策这个知道底细的人才会对萧强这一招不以为意。
果然本不该有意外的却出乎所有人的意料之外。
只听“铛”
的一声，众人看见萧天胸前不知何时横着一把巨剑。
巨剑稳稳的挡住了萧强这看似强大无比的一击。
没有出现众人想象的画面，只是这一幕更让人震撼。
萧强也是没有想到他全力的一击竟被萧天轻描淡写的挡住了，而且他能感受到从巨剑上传来巨大力量使得他的长枪不能再前进一丝！
这一幕也是让萧强诧异不已，也是让他的脸上凝重了起来。
“想不到你的战力那么强，应该能跟锻体境八层天初期修为媲美了，那我也不再留手。”
萧强开口道
萧天点点头，清淡道“开始吧”
只见萧强开始蓄力，周身气息开始流转，阵阵气流盘旋枪身而上，汇聚枪尖。

随后萧强大喊道“看枪，武技，猎鹰枪！”
随着萧强的话音刚落，萧强跃上半空，真元疯狂灌注枪尖，一声狂鹰怒啸，一头如鹰型气劲携带万斤重力冲向萧天。
众人也是目瞪口呆，这可是真元化形，最起码得是玄阶武技，而且真元化形也是先天境的标志。
说明萧强这一击自己媲美一般的先天境修炼者的实力了？
看到如此强大的一击，同在八号擂台得另外两人对视一眼，都看到对方的震惊和担忧。
观众则是兴奋呐喊起来“萧强第一”
“萧强最强……”
可是最有可能希望看到的场景往往是最难遇到的。
所以没有意外，萧强再次挡住了，跟刚刚没有什么区别，也是轻松无比。
可能唯一不同的是，这一次萧天是把重剑举过头顶的，稳稳接住萧强的招式。
而众人也再一次看傻了眼。
心里只有一个念头“这特么的是废物，那我自己是什么东西？废物都不如。”
当萧强看到萧天如此简单的的挡住他的最强一击，也是已经彻底死心了。
content_en:
The audience below also became excited.
The loser who had always been a loser suddenly turned into a master in the physical training realm, and now he had to face off against Xiao Qiang, the younger generation's 'number one' in the family.
There is nothing more attractive than this!
I saw Xiao Qiang take the lead, stabbing forward with a spear, hitting Xiao Tian's chest.
The surrounding spiritual energy also flows with Xiao Qiang's moves, which shows how powerful this move is and directly shows that Xiao Qiang has attacked with all his strength.
Seeing this scene, everyone watching had already begun to imagine the scene of Xiao Tian being shot away.
After all, in their opinion, there is a huge gap between the strength of the two at the sixth level.
So it's no wonder that they don't think highly of Xiao Tian.
Only Xiao Xuance, who knew the details, would not take Xiao Qiang's move seriously.
Sure enough, what shouldn't have been an accident was beyond everyone's expectations.
Just listen to "dang"
With a sound, everyone saw a huge sword lying across Xiao Tian's chest.
The giant sword steadily blocked Xiao Qiang's seemingly powerful blow.
The picture that everyone imagined did not appear, but this scene was even more shocking.
Xiao Qiang also did not expect that his full blow was blocked by Xiao Tian in an understatement, and he could feel the huge power coming from the giant sword, which prevented his spear from moving any further!
This scene also surprised Xiao Qiang, and made his face become solemn.
"I didn't expect your combat power to be so strong. It should be comparable to your cultivation level at the early stage of the eighth level of the body forging realm, so I won't hold back any more."
Xiao Qiang said
Xiao Tian nodded and said calmly, "Let's get started."
I saw Xiao Qiang beginning to accumulate strength, and the aura around his body began to flow. Waves of air flow circled up the gun body and gathered at the tip of the gun.
Then Xiao Qiang shouted, "Look at the gun, the martial arts, the falcon gun!"
As soon as Xiao Qiang's words fell, Xiao Qiang jumped into the air, his true energy was poured into the tip of the gun crazily, and with a roar of an eagle, an eagle-shaped head rushed towards Xiao Tian carrying ten thousand kilograms of gravity.
Everyone was also stunned, this was the transformation of true energy, at least it was a Xuan level martial arts, and the transformation of true energy was also a sign of the innate realm.
Does this mean that Xiao Qiang's attack is comparable to the strength of ordinary Xiantian realm practitioners?
Seeing such a powerful blow, the other two people in the No. 8 ring looked at each other and saw each other's shock and worry.
The audience was excited and shouted "Xiao Qiang is the first"
"Xiao Qiang is the strongest..."
But the scenes you are most likely to want to see are often the most difficult to encounter.
So there was no surprise. Xiao Qiang blocked it again. It was no different from just now, and it was also extremely easy.
Perhaps the only difference is that this time Xiao Tian raised the heavy sword above his head and firmly caught Xiao Qiang's moves.
And everyone was dumbfounded once again.
There was only one thought in my mind: "This thing is trash, so who am I? I am worse than trash."
When Xiao Qiang saw Xiao Tian blocking his strongest blow so easily, he gave up completely.
